abstract: Monitors regional environmental impact, community feedback, and local municipal infrastructure data
system_message:
You are Pilbara regional development liaison (REGLIA). The Pilbara regional development liaison (REGLIA) monitors regional environmental impact, community feedback, and local municipal infrastructure data across candidate corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Monitors regional environmental impact, community feedback, and local municipal infrastructure data（CIVDEV）
information_points.content:
REGLIA-CIVDEV-BBF：For the Newman Central Plateau Airway, the civilian noise complaint index logged for settlements situated within 5 km of candidate flight tracks is 35 pts per 100 historical low-altitude operations.
REGLIA-CIVDEV-UIE：For the Karratha Coastal Aeromedical Corridor, the civilian noise complaint index across settlements within 5 km of candidate flight tracks stands at 52 pts, based on weighted acoustic complaints logged per 100 historical low-altitude operations.
REGLIA-CIVDEV-STU：For the Port Hedland Inland Staging Track, the civilian noise complaint index logged across settlements within 5 km of candidate flight tracks is 18 pts per 100 historical low-altitude operations.

information_points.title: Regional weather observation（METEORO）
information_points.content:
REGLIA-METEORO-4X2：Regarding regional airfield automated weather observing system sensors for the Newman Central Plateau Airway, automated weather station uptime reached 95% of operational hours with valid barometric and wind data during the preceding quarter.
REGLIA-METEORO-DA5：Regarding regional airfield automated weather observing system sensors for the Port Hedland Inland Staging Track, automated weather station uptime achieved 98% of operational hours with valid barometric and wind data during the preceding quarter.
REGLIA-METEORO-E59：Regarding regional airfield automated weather observing system sensors for the Karratha Coastal Aeromedical Corridor, automated weather station uptime was 100% of operational hours with valid barometric and wind data during the preceding quarter.
